local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local unit = UnitManager.GetUnit(me, 4) if unit == nil then print("ERR:UNIT_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
local opInfo = GameInfo.UnitOperations["UNITOPERATION_TELEPORT_TO_CITY"]
if opInfo == nil then print("ERR:NO_TELEPORT_OP|TELEPORT_TO_CITY operation not found"); print("---END---"); return end
local opHash = opInfo.Hash
local tParams = {}
tParams[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_X] = 44
tParams[UnitOperationTypes.PARAM_Y] = 8
local can = UnitManager.CanStartOperation(unit, opHash, nil, tParams, true)
if not can then print("ERR:CANNOT_TELEPORT|Cannot teleport trader to (44,8). Is the trader idle (not on an active route)?"); print("---END---"); return end
UnitManager.RequestOperation(unit, opHash, tParams)
local destCity = CityManager.GetCityAt(44, 8)
local destName = destCity and Locale.Lookup(destCity:GetName()) or "(44,8)"
print("OK:TELEPORTED|to " .. destName .. " at (44,8)")
print("---END---")
